item.title: Re: so i made this scp called the human mp3 player
item.content:encoded:
So, to start with, you aren't supposed to link sandbox drafts just yet if I recall. If you haven't been published on the wiki before you publish drafts you have to come here and get the greenlight here. That doesn't mean you get around the restriction by dumping your draft into this forum. There's a form you need to fill out in less than 400 words. If I have to fill it out, then so do you. Its not fair to everyone else who followed the rules and read the instructions for you to try and jump the que.

And I'm going to put a huge damper on your idea. Because any cyborg or android can do what's described in this article if they have a usb port and a wireless connection.

+ show block
– hide block

A long time ago I had a multiverse fanfic universe, and my main character had a steadily evolving cybernetic arm. One of her bad habits was to use it to play music while she was fighting, and when told she'd give her position to an enemy away she simply had it play in her head in the middle of battle so that she was the only one hearing it.

Then there's the ghost in the shell anime/manga universe, where this cyborg's behavior would be seen as a computer virus, and thus he'd be seen as the victim of a terrible crime. Because his free will would have been overridden by a hacker. This is a universe that dwarfs what your guy can do, because your average person can surf the internet inside their head, backup their memories, replace any part of their body with one that's almost a perfect realistic replica, you get the picture. They've even got more than enough augments to make a cyborg into a superhero, and they don't even go into the more gory ways this technology could be used to save lives.

The SCP Universe even has hyper realistic androids and cyborgs of varying degrees. There's Anderson robotics, and the Asimov's Lawbringers MTF that fights them. There's MTF Tau-5 Samsara as well, which played a prominent role in the story of Site 13.

In general, I suggest you do more research into futurism concepts. In fact I recommend this youtube creator, as he has an entire 28 video long playlist on the ins and outs of integrating technology into the human mind and body as well as what androids and cyborgs would realistically look like and what machine intelligence tropes will probably never exist due to their impracticality. He also explains the limitations of this technology, important to keep in mind, and examines examples from actual science fiction including the grandfather of robot centric sci fi, Isaac Asimov. Just don't forget to grab a drink and a snack. ;) https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZFipeZtQM5CKUjx6grh54g/playlists

I strongly recommend this channel to anyone looking to write a realistic science fiction story, (or SCP) because of the sheer level of detail he goes into. And as a retired military engineer, he knows a lot more about the subjects he covers than I do.

Please collapse long posts as a courtesy to our mobile users. —RockTeethMothEyes
